review:
Divine Queen: Heart of Ice is a pay-anywhere slot built around a special multiplier reel controlled by an ice queen. Multipliers up to 500x can appear in both the main game and the bonus.

You can earn up to 14 free spins with possible retriggers. A feature raises the bet slightly to improve your odds of free spins, and the bonus buy brings four or more scatters on the next spin where permitted. BGaming rates the game medium-high volatility with a 5,000x maximum and a 97% RTP. Free spins arrive about once every 250 spins on average. The separate multiplier reel makes the boost easy to follow.
pros: Excellent 97.00% RTP – among the highest published

cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
